title: EF Core: Raw SQL & Compiled Queries

scenes.line1: Can you optimize EF Core queries?
scenes.say: Entity Framework Core lets you run raw SQL and compiled queries. Do you know when to use each for best performance?

scenes.label: FromSqlRaw
scenes.sub: Use raw SQL for complex queries or when LINQ can't express what you need.
scenes.say: FromSqlRaw lets you run direct SQL for cases where LINQ falls short, like complex joins or custom logic.
Compiled queries cache the query plan. This speeds up repeated executions with different parameters.
Raw SQL gives flexibility and control. Compiled queries shine when you need speed on frequent requests.

scenes.question: When should you use compiled queries?
scenes.right: When a query runs often with different parameters, compiled queries cut overhead.
scenes.say: Don't use compiled queries for every query. They're best for high-traffic paths with changing parameters.
